basis.governing_question: What strategy should Banco Horizonte follow for its digital channels?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Assess how Banco Horizonte's digital channels perform today and what the CEO and Head of Digital expect from them.

gate.label: Research focus
gate.decision: Which channel gaps should the customer and competitor research take forward?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Establish what customers need from digital channels and how peer banks run theirs, as evidence for the strategy.

gate.label: Design focus
gate.decision: Which customer needs and peer practices should the strategy options build on?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the digital channels strategy and roadmap for Banco Horizonte, ready for approval by the CEO and Head of Digital.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the digital channels strategy and roadmap as the final result?

workstreams.name: Leadership expectations
workstreams.answers: What role do the CEO and Head of Digital expect the digital channels to play for the bank?
activities: Interview the CEO and the Head of Digital in two rounds
Review the bank's strategy and planning documents
Compare the two sets of expectations and note differences

workstreams.name: Channel performance today
workstreams.answers: How are the bank's digital channels used today, and how well do the customer journeys work?
activities: Analyze usage and performance data for each channel
Map the customer journeys in each channel
Interview the staff who run and support each channel

workstreams.name: Channel gap synthesis
workstreams.answers: Where do the digital channels fall short of what the CEO and Head of Digital expect?
activities: Set channel findings against leadership expectations
Rank the gaps by effect on customers and on the bank
Prepare the gap list for the Research focus decision

workstreams.name: Customer needs: segments 1-2
workstreams.answers: What do customers in the first two retail segments need and expect from the bank's digital channels?
activities: Interview customers in two segments about digital use
Analyze digital behavior data for the same segments
Summarize needs and pain points for each segment

workstreams.name: Customer needs: segment 3
workstreams.answers: What do customers in the remaining retail segment need and expect from the bank's digital channels?
activities: Interview customers in the third segment about digital use
Analyze digital behavior data for the third segment
Summarize needs and pain points for the segment

workstreams.name: Peer bank digital benchmark
workstreams.answers: How do peer banks position and run their digital channels?
activities: Select the peer banks to compare with Banco Horizonte
Collect public information on peer banks' digital channels
Compare peer positioning and operation with the bank's

workstreams.name: Customer and peer synthesis
workstreams.answers: Which customer needs and peer practices should the strategy options build on?
activities: Combine customer and peer findings into one evidence base
Rank needs and peer practices for the gate decision
Note what the evidence does not yet show

workstreams.name: Strategic option set
workstreams.answers: Which strategic options for its digital channels could Banco Horizonte take, given the research findings?
activities: Derive candidate options from customer and peer evidence
Describe what each option means for the bank's channels
Agree criteria: fit, effort, cost and delivery capability

workstreams.name: Option comparison
workstreams.answers: How do the options compare on customer fit, leadership expectations, effort, cost and delivery capability?
activities: Score each option against the agreed criteria
Gather staff input on effort, cost and delivery capability
Prepare the comparison for the options workshop

workstreams.name: Strategy and roadmap
workstreams.answers: What roadmap turns the chosen digital channels strategy into sequenced steps for the bank?
activities: Write the target strategy for the chosen option
Sequence the roadmap steps and their dependencies
Check the roadmap steps with the staff who would run them

workstreams.name: Client review and sign-off
workstreams.answers: What changes do the CEO and Head of Digital need before they can approve the strategy and roadmap?
activities: Walk the CEO and Head of Digital through the draft
Collect their comments and revise the strategy and roadmap
Prepare the final readout for approval

deliverables.name: CEO and Head of Digital expectations summary
Digital channel performance and customer journey findings
Ranked channel gap list for Research focus decision
Customer needs findings for the first two segments
Customer needs findings for the remaining segment
Customer and peer evidence base for design focus
Digital channels strategic options and criteria
Option comparison against the agreed criteria
Draft digital channels strategy and roadmap
Digital channels strategy and roadmap for approval

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Agree access and start the Diagnostic
events.decision: Which digital channel data and people will the team have access to in weeks 1-5?
agenda: Present the Diagnostic workstreams and what each needs from the bank
Discuss access to channel performance data and to leadership time
Decide the data and people access for weeks 1-5

events.label: Check-in: expectations
events.decision: Which leadership expectations should the channel gap ranking be measured against?
agenda: Present the CEO and Head of Digital expectations summary
Review progress on the channel performance work
Decide which expectations anchor the channel gap ranking

events.label: Research focus
events.purpose: Choose the channel gaps to research
events.decision: Which channel gaps should the customer and competitor research take forward?
agenda: Present the channel performance and customer journey findings
Review the ranked channel gap list against leadership expectations
Decide which channel gaps the customer and competitor research covers

events.label: Check-in: customer needs
events.purpose: Review customer needs ahead of benchmark
events.decision: Which customer needs should the peer bank benchmark focus on?
agenda: Present customer needs findings for all three segments
Discuss how the needs differ across segments
Decide the customer needs the peer bank benchmark focuses on

events.label: Design focus
events.purpose: Choose the evidence the options build on
events.decision: Which customer needs and peer practices should the strategy options build on?
agenda: Present the peer bank digital channel benchmark
Review the customer and peer evidence base for design focus
Decide which needs and practices the strategy options build on

events.label: Workshop: option comparison
events.decision: Which strategic option should the strategy and roadmap detail?
agenda: Present the strategic options and the criteria
Review the option comparison against the agreed criteria
Decide which option the strategy and roadmap will detail

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Approve the digital channels strategy and roadmap as the final result?
agenda: Present the strategy and roadmap for approval
Review the strategy and roadmap against the chosen option
Decide on approval of the strategy and roadmap

architect_notes: No engagement length was given, so the 16 to 22 weeks in total is an estimate from the sized work; confirm it before quoting.
The counts of 3 digital channels and 3 customer segments are assumed and drive the Diagnostic and Research lengths; confirm both with the client.
No firm archetype fits a digital channels strategy for an existing bank, so phases and work pieces are planned from the brief and common units.
Only three weeks follow the G6 workshop, so strategy writing gets one week, below the sized two to three; client review gets two.

sub_questions.question: How do Banco Horizonte's digital channels perform today, and where do they fall short?
What role do the CEO and Head of Digital expect digital channels to play for the bank?
What do retail customers need and expect from the bank's digital channels?
How do peer banks position and run their digital channels?
Which strategic options for the digital channels fit the bank, and which one should be taken forward?
What roadmap turns the chosen strategy into sequenced steps for the bank?

phases.name: Diagnostic

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Digital channel assessed (usage, customer journeys, performance)

phases.why: Both interview rounds run together, then the three channels are assessed side by side; fixed weeks cover start-up and synthesis.

phases.name: Research

work.unit: Customer segment researched (needs, digital behavior, interviews)

phases.why: Segments are researched two at a time, then the peer benchmark; one week synthesizes for the gate.

phases.name: Design

work.unit: Strategic options for the digital channels compared

phases.why: Options are compared first, then the target strategy and roadmap are written; one review cycle with the client precedes the final readout.

sizing.levers: Researching fewer customer segments, benchmarking peers from desk data only, or assessing fewer channels would shorten the engagement most.
